title: Moon phase
tagline: Tonight’s moon, drawn live from the sky’s own clock.
teaser: The phase of the moon for today or any date you pick, drawn live on your screen. A quiet toy for sky-watchers and night owls.

manPage.synopsis: pom — see the moon’s phase for today or any date you choose.
manPage.description: Keith E. Brandt’s pom printed the phase of the moon as a line of text, using formulas from Peter Duffett-Smith’s Practical Astronomy with Your Calculator. This version draws the moon itself.

howToPlay: Pick any date, past or future.
Watch the moon grow and shrink through its phases.
Find the next full moon, or the next new one.
